ruleset.name: register
ruleset.description: Size limits, unused parameters and System.out (conventions section 11).

rule.name: MethodLength
rule.message: A method or constructor is at most 30 lines (SA-2.3-1).
rule.description: A method or constructor is at most 30 lines, from its signature to its closing brace.

rule.name: ClassLength
rule.message: A class is at most 300 lines (SA-2.3-2).
rule.description: A top-level type is at most 300 lines.

rule.name: NestingDepth
rule.message: Control statements nest at most 3 deep (SA-2.3-4).
rule.description: A control statement inside three others is too deep; an else-if continues its if, it does not nest.

property.name: xpath

rule.message: A method takes at most 4 parameters; more become a record or a parameter object (SA-2.3-3).
The cyclomatic complexity of a method is at most 10 (SA-2.3-5).
No System.out or System.err; log through the logger (SA-2.4-7).
